name: Basilisk Spit Gland
description: Modifies the parotid salivary glands to produce a concentrated cytotoxic compound and restructures the oral musculature to project it accurately up to 3 meters. The spit is not truly acidic — it's a blend of phospholipase and cytolytic enzymes that cause rapid tissue destruction on contact, particularly targeting mucous membranes and eyes. A direct hit to the eyes causes immediate, excruciating pain, temporary blindness, and permanent damage without rapid medical treatment. The modification includes a secondary gland that produces a neutralizing compound, allowing the user to flush their own mouth after production. Gravemoss Biofoundry's installation includes accuracy training via neural modification to the targeting circuits — users can hit a target's eyes at 3 meters with practiced reliability. The modification is named for the mythical basilisk whose gaze killed; the Basilisk Spit doesn't kill, but eye contact with its users has taken on a new and uncomfortable meaning.
source_organism: Naja nigricollis (black-necked spitting cobra), synthetic cytotoxic enzyme blend
procedure: Oral surgery with gland modification and neural targeting integration, 2 sessions
expression_time: 4–6 weeks for gland maturation; targeting accuracy improves over 3 months of practice
reversibility: Glands surgically removable; neural targeting changes persist
side_effects: Bitter, metallic taste in mouth when venom reserves are full
Accidental discharge during coughing or sneezing
Chronic dry mouth from modified salivary gland function
Social isolation — people are uncomfortable around someone who can blind them from across a room
social_perception: Deeply stigmatized. The ability to spit blinding venom is considered aggressive and threatening regardless of the user's intent. Spitter users face severe social consequences — avoided in public, banned from many establishments, and subject to mandatory disclosure laws. The modification marks the user as someone who has chosen violence as a capability.
story_hooks: A Spitter's venom composition changes to include a paralytic compound not present in the original installation — the modified glands are evolving, and the new venom is more dangerous than intended

A series of blinding attacks across the Shelf are attributed to a Spitter, but the enzyme profile doesn't match any registered user — someone has synthesized the venom artificially to frame the geneware community
